text: In the 113th Congress we opened by counting ourselves. Thirteen of us said "the 113th congress." Then the record narrows to one demand. Sixteen of us said "no budget no pay," peaking on 2013-01-23; fourteen said "the no budget no pay," nine "the no budget no pay act." Fourteen of us said "pass a budget," ten "to pass a budget"—Scott DesJarlais said "pass a budget" first, on 2013-01-04, before the others arrived at the same words on the same day. Eight of us said "the fiscal cliff." Seven said "court of appeals for the." We record that the convergence was near-total on the budget line and dated to a single peak day, 2013-01-23. We do not know from this record why we chose those words. We know how many of us chose them, and when.
